job.title: [Post] ... Hybris DevOps Engineer for an exciting remote opportunity! Position: SAP Hybris DevOps…

tailoring.headline: SAP Hybris DevOps Engineer | 5+ Years SAP Commerce Cloud, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes. Proven record in designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, optimizing database performance, and bridging business and IT through techno-functional analysis and AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Hybris DevOps Engineer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about the remote SAP Hybris DevOps Engineer role at Anushka Sharma, where I can combine my deep SAP Commerce expertise with proven DevOps practices. Over the past 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have built and operated robust Hybris platforms, delivering CI/CD pipelines, Docker containers and Kubernetes orchestration.

bullets.label: CI/CD Expertise
bullets.text: Executed end-to-end CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) using Jenkins, automating builds and releases for high-availability e-commerce services.

bullets.label: Container Orchestration
bullets.text: Implemented Docker-based microservices and managed Kubernetes clusters to ensure scalable, resilient Hybris environments across cloud infrastructures.

bullets.label: Integration Pipelines
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, guaranteeing seamless product data flow between ERP, MDM and storefronts.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Acted as a bridge between business and IT, translating stakeholder requirements into functional specifications, user stories and reliable Hybris solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to discuss further.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to Anushka Sharma’s commitment to pioneering remote-first e-commerce solutions built on SAP Hybris. Your focus on DevOps excellence aligns perfectly with my experience automating CI/CD pipelines, containerizing services and driving seamless integrations. Contributing to a forward-thinking team that values innovation and flexibility would allow me to leverage my SAP Commerce and DevOps background to accelerate platform reliability and business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: Join Anushka Sharma to apply my 5+ years SAP Hybris expertise and DevOps skills, driving reliable, scalable e-commerce solutions in a fully remote, innovative environment.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Hybris DevOps specialist with 5+ years experience at Rockwell and Shell. I’m eager to bring my CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes expertise to your remote team. Could we discuss the SAP Hybris DevOps Engineer role?
tailoring.email_subject: SAP Hybris DevOps Engineer – Application – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Hybris DevOps Engineer position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience and a strong DevOps background, I am ready to contribute to your remote team. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value.

Best regards
